notes.subject: rop bilong nating
notes.rationale: חבלי השוא — rop bilong olsem nating/giaman; toksave long pasin pulim sin olsem rop.

notes.subject: ol i pulim pasin nogut
notes.rationale: Tok 'O sori' i toktok daun long ol man nogut bilong Yerusalayim.

notes.subject: השוא / העון
notes.rationale: Contrast namel long rop liklik (rop bilong nating) na rop bilong karet — piksa i go antap, lost long Tok Pisin.

translation: O sori long ol i pulim ⟨את⟩ pasin nogut wantaim rop bilong nating, na ⟨את⟩ sin, olsem wantaim ol strongpela rop bilong karet.

tokens.gloss: na olsem wantaim ol strongpela rop bilong
